title: The pricing page nobody reads (Copy)
name: The pricing page nobody reads (Copy)
hook: Nobody reads your pricing page. They read the first number.
transcript: Nobody reads your pricing page. They read the first number and the button under it. We tested six versions last quarter, and the only change that moved anything was putting the most popular plan in the middle and saying who it is for in five words. Everything else, the comparison table, the FAQ, the badges, was decoration.
